item.title: Middle East Eye: US imposes new Iran-related sanctions
item.description: US imposes new Iran-related sanctions The US treasury department imposed new sanctions targeting individuals and entities involved in an Iranian "shadow banking" network, it said on Monday. item.title: Middle East Eye: Iran says it downed US drone over Qeshm Island
item.description: Iran says it downed US drone over Qeshm Island Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has said that it has destroyed a US Predator drone over Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
